title: Expanding groups with large diameter
summary: We study how the spectral gap and diameter of Cayley graphs depend strongly on the choice of generating set. We answer a question of Pyber and Szabó (2013) by exhibiting a sequence of finite groups $G_n$ with $|G_n| \to \infty$ admitting bounded generating sets $X_n,Y_n$ such that $\operatorname{Cay}(G_n,X_n)$ is an expander while $\operatorname{Cay}(G_n,Y_n)$ has super-polylogarithmic diameter. The construction uses the semidirect product $G_n = C_p^{n-1} \rtimes S_n$ with $p$ exponentially large in $n$, and the analysis reduces to bounding some exponential sums of permutational type.
